ornament_set.notes: First-listed ornament (JingYuan.ts:356): The Wondrous BananAmusement Park (+16% CRIT DMG, +32% more while a target the wearer summoned is on the field; whether Lightning-Lord counts is Fribbels' modelling and unchecked here).

main_stats.notes: Fribbels options: Body CRIT Rate/CRIT DMG, Feet ATK%/SPD, Sphere ATK%/Lightning DMG, Rope ATK%. GUESS: Body CRIT Rate (proxy +5.1% over CRIT DMG). GUESS: Feet SPD, same reason as Acheron (SPD boots in the 0% baseline, benchmarks.md:65). Sphere Lightning DMG (proxy +9.7% over ATK%). Rope ATK% is the only option.

distributed.notes: Fribbels substat list: CRIT DMG, CRIT Rate, ATK%, ATK. Rolls chosen with a throwaway proxy script (damage ~ scale stat x (1 + CR x CD) x (1 + DMG%), the 2 fixed rolls per stat, the per-relic cap, simple set and trace stats only, an assumed 635 ATK / 1058 HP light cone), not with Fribbels or the kernel. Treat it as a tie-breaker, not a result. Result: crit rolls fill toward their caps (CRIT DMG 11, CRIT Rate 10). SPD: 3 rolls. 99 + 25.032 + 4.6 = 128.63; 2 rolls give 133.23, just under 133.34; 3 give 135.53. GUESS: Jing Yuan's own Lightning-Lord timing may want a different tune; the kit file will show it. SPD arithmetic ignores light cone and team SPD buffs. The cycle-1 two-turn threshold is 133.34 (20000/150); src/engine/breakpoints.test.ts pins 134 as 2 turns and 133 as 1.
